question: Under which scheme is the 12.9 km Sonprayag–Kedarnath ropeway project being developed by the Adani Group?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parvatmala Pariyojana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Adani Group is constructing a 12.9 km ropeway from Sonprayag to Kedarnath under the National Ropeways Development Programme—Parvatmala Pariyojana, aiming to cut travel time from 9 hours to just 36 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ropeway will span 12.9 km, connecting Sonprayag to Kedarnath, reducing travel time from nearly nine hours to 36 minutes.**
 
• **The ₹4,081 crore project will use Tri-cable Detachable Gondola (3S) technology, ensuring stability and safety in high-altitude terrain.**
 
• **It will have a carrying capacity of 1,800 passengers per hour per direction, catering to thousands of Char Dham pilgrims.**
 
• **Adani Enterprises Ltd received the Letter of Award in September 2025 and will construct the ropeway under the PPP model, operating it for 29 years after a six-year construction period.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Parvatmala Pariyojana__

 __
 
• Launched by the Government of India to promote ropeway development in hilly and difficult terrains.
 
• Aims to improve connectivity, reduce travel time, and promote tourism in mountainous regions.
 
• Encourages Public-Private Partnership (PPP) for efficient implementation.
 
 
 
• Project Details__
 __
 
• Cost: ₹4,081 crore
 
• Length: 12.9 km
 
• Technology: 3S (Tri-cable Detachable Gondola)
 
• Time reduction: 9 hours to 36 minutes
 
• Capacity: 1,800 passengers/hour/direction
 
 
 
• Regional Impact__
 
 
• Boosts tourism and employment in Uttarakhand’s high-altitude region.
 
• Ensures safer travel for pilgrims, especially the elderly and differently-abled.
 
• Promotes local economic development while maintaining environmental safeguards.
 
 

2c
